create.name: Ayya Santussika
create.bio:
Ayya Santussika is a Theravada Buddhist nun and the founder of Karuna Buddhist Vihara, a small monastery for bhikkhunis in northern California. Raised on a farm in Indiana, she spent fifteen years designing software in Silicon Valley and later completed a Master of Divinity through an interfaith seminary. Repeated journeys to Thailand from 1999 onwards, and time at Abhayagiri Monastery, drew her towards monastic life; she first took robes in 2005 and received full bhikkhuni ordination in 2012, the year she set up the vihara.

Her teaching rests closely on the Pali suttas. With Ayya Cittananda, the other resident nun, she lives at the vihara's forest hermitage in the Santa Cruz Mountains and leads its public programme at the meditation centre in Sunnyvale: a Friday evening of chanting, sitting and sutta discussion, and a Saturday morning session on bringing the Dhamma into ordinary difficulties, both open in person and on Zoom and offered freely. She also teaches residential retreats at centres such as the Insight Meditation Society, Cloud Mountain and the Barre Center for Buddhist Studies. Many of her talks are on the vihara's YouTube channel, and she wrote the short book Relief, which the vihara gives away.

free_resources.title: Friday Sutta Study
free_resources.description: A weekly two-hour evening at the Sunnyvale meditation centre and on Zoom: optional chanting and a sitting, then reading and talking through a discourse from the Pali Canon. Free and open to people of any faith, who may come and go as they wish.

free_resources.title: How do I apply the Dhamma to THIS!?!
free_resources.description: A Saturday morning session, in person and online, with a talk, questions and often a guided sitting, on meeting everyday problems with Buddhist practice. Recordings go up on the vihara's YouTube channel.

free_resources.title: Relief
free_resources.description: A short book by Ayya Santussika, free to download as a PDF from the vihara's books page.

free_resources.title: Brahma Viharas (guided meditation)
free_resources.description: An audio recording of her leading a sitting on kindness, compassion, joy and equanimity, recorded at Insight Meditation Center in Redwood City.

free_resources.title: Self-Guided Upasika Training Program
free_resources.description: Month-by-month readings, exercises and supporting texts from a lay training course once run at the vihara, now posted for individuals or peer groups to work through. Meant for people who already know the main Buddhist ideas.
